snippet.description:
What does history look like when you can actually hold it in your hands?

Nikhil Sir brings out two original historical coins: a silver rupee of Sher Shah Suri and an ancient punch-marked coin associated with the Magadha Mahajanapada. He examines their material, scripts and other details to show how coins serve as sources of history.

From the early history of Indian coinage to the clues preserved in inscriptions, discover how these small objects can tell us so much about the past.
